Vicar of Otterbourne 1881-1892

He married (3 Jan 1882) Amy Gabrielle Powell (d. 10 Feb 1947). He served as vicar of Otterbourne from 1881, resigned 1892 and until his death was Rector of St Pierre-du-Bois, Guernsey (succeeding his father, the Very Rev Carey Brock, 1824-1892, dean of Guernsey). [John Keble’s Parishes; LG 1952 Brock]
